notes.title: Blank Wallpaper is revolutionizing computer desktops into icon - free spaces
notes.notes:
I find that many people still don't understand the role of Blank Wallpaper. Maybe you think it's a built-in feature of Windows and useless.

I can clearly say that this is the ultimate beautification form of a computer desktop.

First, do you agree that hiding all icons and the taskbar can make the desktop neatest and make the wallpapers of Wallpaper Engine look better?

Second, Blank Wallpaper is much stronger than the beautification software on the market. It occupies less than 5M, has no background processes, and does not consume computer performance.

Moreover, Blank Wallpaper ignores your computer proficiency. [b]Whether you are a computer geek or a novice, it allows you to easily master this icon-free mode. It enables you to use the computer normally without any settings, and the way to open software is better than before. The purpose of the software is to make you no longer see the icons on the desktop and enter the icon-free mode.[/b]

Finally, the software has some functions of its own, such as setting shortcuts to open any file, setting any file in the right-click menu, etc. These are just optimizations for operations, and you can easily master them without settings.

I just want to express my opinion. You can also purchase and experience it before evaluating, as you can get a refund within two hours after all.

notes.title: Updated: Support dropping
notes.notes:
1. Added the drop function, now drop a time seed every hour online. Make the time spent with the software more meaningful. It is possible to record the number of days of use, and of course, it can also be traded, and the trading function will be improved in the future.
2. Fix the auto-start problem, and fix that some systems can't start auto-start.
3. Fix the update problem, you don't need to manually close the program for each update, you can update normally.
4. Support to close Steam manually, you can close Steam without closing the program

notes.title: Major update: Compatible Wallpaper Engine, live wallpapers only support video
notes.notes:
With this update, the software is no longer falsely reported as a virus. Players can use it with confidence.
The shortcut keys you set will need to be set again.
The function is the same as the old version, temporarily removing the interface to the dynamic mouse, streamlining some functions to make it easier for users to use.
Currently, users only need to click on "Perfect Desktop" and "Auto" to complete the configuration.
New version that supports video files as wallpapers. Intelligently pause playback in the form of whether the window is full-screen. Shortcuts are still supported.
Other features of the new version are the same as the old version, but there may be bugs in some computers, so it is not recommended for old users to update this version.

notes.title: 2025-04-09 Added Workshop
notes.notes:
The Workshop has been changed to English prompts.
Because in the last update, the program was not started as an administrator, which will cause the add context menu to fail, so the program still needs to be started by an administrator.
You can upload and download wallpapers in the Workshop, but be careful.
The program was falsely reported to the virus, and it had already taken me too much effort to deal with it, resulting in no new features coming online. There will be a brand new version in the near future, but I can't guarantee that it will be better than the current one, but it won't be falsely reported as a virus.
